data.long_meaning: The name Ishanika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ishana’ meaning God and ‘Nika’ meaning rule or ruler. This name signifies the one who rules or governs God. In Hindu mythology, Ishan is a name of Shiva, the supreme deity, symbolizing the ruler of the universe.
